saintapediagraph-error-missing-tables: Error when tables= is omitted outside dual mode.
saintapediagraph-error-missing-parent: Error when parent_field is missing in hierarchy mode.
saintapediagraph-error-missing-edge-fiel: Error when source/target fields are incomplete.
saintapediagraph-error-missing-mode: Error when no relationship mode parameters are provided.
saintapediagraph-error-mixed-modes: Error when hierarchy and edge parameters are mixed.
saintapediagraph-error-missing-dual-tabl: Error when dual mode tables are incomplete.
saintapediagraph-error-dual-needs-params: Error when dual mode is misused from the rows API.
saintapediagraph-error-no-cargo: Error when Cargo is not installed.
saintapediagraph-error-no-results: Error when the query returns zero graphable rows.
saintapediagraph-error-query: Cargo query failure. $1 is the underlying message.
saintapediagraph-error-expensive: Error when the expensive parser function limit is exceeded.
saintapediagraph-error-render: Client-side render failure (used as element title).
saintapediagraph-warning-cycles: Warning when cycles are found. $1 is an integer cycle count (may over-count overlapping cycles); used with {{PLURAL:$1}} for singular/plural.
saintapediagraph-warning-cycles-broken: Info when edges were removed to break cycles. $1 is an integer edge count; used with {{PLURAL:$1}} for singular/plural.
saintapediagraph-warning-unknown-theme: Warning when theme= (or the default config theme) is not a Mermaid built-in. $1 = requested value, $2 = fallback used.
saintapediagraph-warning-limit-clamped: Editor warning when limit= was adjusted (above $wgSaintapediaGraphMaxLimit, or below 1). $1 = requested value, $2 = effective per-query cap used.
saintapediagraph-warning-limit-clamped-d: Extra editor line in dual mode. $1 = the same per-query cap. Technical 'Cargo query' wording stays here, not in en.json.
